# Sell the grapes, or make your own wine?

> Free vineyard calculator: compare selling grapes by the ton with making and selling your own wine. Net profit, cost per bottle, and the direct-sales share where bottling wins. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
